sql.content: select 0 as rownumber,o.* from ( %(sql)s order by %(orderby)s ) o limit %(firstindex)s,%(pagesize)s
select 0 as rownumber,o.* from ( %(sql)s order by %(orderby)s ) o limit %(pagesize)s offset %(firstindex)s

select u.emp_code, u.first_name, u.last_name,d.dept_code, d.dept_name,p.position_name, ss.salary_amount, ss.effective_date, ms.increase_formula, ms.deduction_formula, ms.early_leave_formula, ms.absent_time_formula, ms.late_time_formula as late_formula from payroll_salarystructure ss left join payroll_monthlysalary ms on ms.employee_id = ss.employee_id inner join personnel_employee u on u.id=ss.employee_id inner join personnel_department d on d.id=u.department_id left join personnel_position p on p.id = u.position_id where ss.effective_date >= '%(st)s' and ss.effective_date <= '%(et)s'
select pl.name, lc.category_name from payroll_leaveformula pl inner join att_leavecategory lc on lc.id = pl.category_id
select count(s.id) as data_count from payroll_salarystructure as s left join personnel_employee u on u.id=s.employee_id where s.effective_date>='%(st)s' and s.effective_date < '%(et)s' and s.status=0
select count(s.id) as data_count from payroll_monthlysalary as s left join personnel_employee u on u.id=s.employee_id where s.calc_time>='%(st)s' and s.calc_time < '%(et)s' and s.status=0

select u.emp_code, u.first_name, u.last_name,d.dept_code, d.dept_name,p.position_name, ms.basic_salary,ms.total_increase_formula_name as all_increase_name, ms.total_increase as other_increase_amount, ms.extra_increse as monthly_increase_amount,ms.total_deduction_formula_name as all_deduction_name, ms.total_deduction as other_deduction_amount, ms.extra_deduction as monthly_deduction_amount ms.total_loan_amount as loan_amount, ms.loan_deduction as loan_refund, ms.refund_loan_amount as remain_repayment, ms.reimbursement,ms.total_salary from payroll_monthlysalary ms inner join personnel_employee u on u.id=ms.employee_id inner join personnel_department d on d.id=u.department_id left join personnel_position p on p.id = u.position_id where ms.calc_time >= '%(st)s' and ms.calc_time <= '%(et)s'
